articles.summary: EdgePoint Partner Lee Matheson Joins Mattel Board of Directors Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) (“Mattel” or the “Company”) today announced that it has entered into a cooperation agreement with EdgePoint Investment Group Inc. (“EdgePoint”), an approximately 18% stockholder of the Company. In conjunction with the cooperation agreement, the Company has appointed Lee Matheson, a Partner at EdgePoint, to the Company’s Board of Directors. Roger Lynch, Chairman and CEO of Mattel, said: “We welcome Lee to Mattel’s Board. Beyond his deep investor and public markets experience, his perspective as a Partner of Mattel’s longstanding and largest shareholder adds a new dimension to our board as we advance our brand-centric strategy and capitalize on the potential of our business.” Professor Noreena Hertz, Chair of Mattel’s Governance and Social Responsibility Committee, said: “Lee brings to Mattel significant public company board experience, as well as an extensive background in investment management
articles.title: Mattel Enters into Cooperation Agreement with EdgePoint Investment Group Inc.

articles.summary: Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) today announced that it plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at approximately 4:05 p.m. Eastern Time. Following this, Mattel will host a webcast conference call at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. The webcast and accompanying slides will be available under the Events and Presentations section of Mattel's Investor Relations website, https://investors.mattel.com . To listen to the webcast, log on to the website at least 10 minutes early to register, download and install any necessary audio software. An archive of the webcast will be available on the Company's website for 12 months following the event. Certain financial and statistical information included in the webcast, such as information required by Regulation G, will be available at the time of the webcast on the "Investors" section of Mattel’s corporate website, https://investors.mattel.com . articles.summary: Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) today announced the appointment of Peter Griffith as Chief Financial Officer, effective October 20, 2026. Griffith succeeds Paul Ruh, who will serve in an advisory role through the end of the year to support an effective transition. Griffith will report to Roger Lynch, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Mattel, and will also join the company’s board of directors. Peter Griffith Lynch said: “Peter is a highly accomplished and respected financial leader with a proven track record of enabling growth, driving financial discipline, and allocating capital strategically. His deep experience spanning global financial management, private equity, and investment banking will be invaluable as we look to sharpen our execution and improve our performance.
